key_decisions.rationale: Keeps divine imitation grounded in beloved kinship.
key_decisions.before: Therefore imitate God as beloved children,
key_decisions.after: Therefore imitate God, as dearly loved children,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves self-giving, cultic terms, and fragrance image.

key_decisions.after: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave himself for us as an offering and sacrifice to God, a fragrant aroma.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave himself up for us, a fragrant offering and sacrifice to God.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps broad categories and community standard.
key_decisions.before: But sexual immorality and every kind of impurity or greed must not even be named among you, as is fitting for holy people,
key_decisions.after: But sexual immorality, every kind of impurity, or greed must not even be named among you, as is fitting for saints.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But sexual immorality and all impurity or greed must not even be named among you, as is fitting for holy ones.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves speech contrasts and thanksgiving wordplay.
key_decisions.before: nor obscenity, foolish talk, or crude joking, which are out of place, but rather thanksgiving.
key_decisions.after: Nor should there be shameful behavior, foolish talk, or crude joking, which are improper, but rather thanksgiving.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Obscenity, foolish talk, or crude joking—things that are out of place—must not be found among you; instead, there is thanksgiving.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps vice identities, greed/idolatry relation, and inheritance.
key_decisions.before: For know this clearly: no sexually immoral, impure, or greedy person—who is an idolater—has an inheritance in Christ’s and God’s kingdom.
key_decisions.after: For know this with certainty: no sexually immoral, impure, or greedy person—who is an idolater—has an inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For you may be sure of this: everyone who is sexually immoral or impure, or who is greedy (that is, an idolater), has no inheritance in the reign of Christ and of God.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves warning, cause, wrath, and kinship idiom.

key_decisions.after: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things God's wrath comes upon the children of disobedience.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the children of disobedience.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves identity contrast and movement command.

key_decisions.after: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light—
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For once you were darkness, but now in the Lord you are light. Walk as children of light—
